current_stage_3.feature: Secure Buti AI final-design to beauty-center reservation bridge
current_stage_3.preview_entry: Active supported service cards expose a Mirror preview CTA; the user must be authenticated.
current_stage_3.return_target: A signed Flask session stores the user, center, active service ID/key, Mirror key, and one-hour expiry; final page revalidates center/service state and returns a same-center booking CTA.
current_stage_3.reservation_validation: GET and POST verify final_design_id ownership, design/service type, service_id, active service state, and beauty-center service_key mapping; invalid links fail closed.
current_stage_3.privacy: No customer photo is sent to or displayed to the salon. Only internal design reference and service/style metadata are linked; the reservation UI says so explicitly.
current_stage_3.ordinary_reservation: Normal reservations without a final_design_id remain supported.

current_stage_4.feature: Instagram profile link and outbound referral click tracking
current_stage_4.owner_field: Owner can enter username or profile URL; input is normalized to https://www.instagram.com/{username}/ and invalid hosts, queries, fragments, and non-profile paths are rejected.
current_stage_4.public_cta: A public Instagram CTA is shown only when the center has a valid saved profile.
current_stage_4.redirect_security: Redirect route looks up the saved profile for the same published/active center and ignores user-supplied next/target URLs.
current_stage_4.tracking: Existing beauty_center_events is extended additively with service_id and campaign_key; only aggregate events are stored, service attribution must be active and owned by the center, and owner/staff clicks are suppressed.
current_stage_4.tests: Dedicated Stage 4 module: 7 passed. Combined stages 1–4 center/gallery/CTA/Booking Bridge/Buti AI regression before Stage 5: 58 passed, 132 warnings.

architecture_findings.runtime_catalog: Runtime catalog labels eyebrow/nail/hair_color/lip_shading active; blush and eyeliner are absent from runtime routes/modules.

current_stage_5.feature: Dynamic public service-demand board, owner analytics and admin city/service aggregation
current_stage_5.public_page: The existing four headline metrics remain. A 30-day demand section is inserted before filters and derives labels/groups from active services at published centers; no hardcoded brow/lip/hair list.
current_stage_5.service_change_behavior: Grouping uses current service_key or current service name fallback, so active inventory changes affect the list automatically.
current_stage_5.booking_start_definition: A valid service reservation-form GET; one event per signed browser session/day per center-service. This is an interaction count, not a unique-person or completed-booking count.
current_stage_5.privacy: New booking_start rows use user_id=0 and store only center/service/source. No photo, final_design_id, phone or visitor identifier is captured.
current_stage_5.public_threshold: Exact public demand is shown only at or above BEAUTY_SERVICE_DEMAND_MIN_SAMPLE (default 5; environment-adjustable 1–100); below it the page says there is not enough data.
current_stage_5.owner_dashboard: Analytics tab offers 7/30/90-day event and reservation-state totals scoped to the owner's resolved center, with service breakdown from that center's current service rows.
current_stage_5.admin_dashboard: Aggregate 30-day service demand grouped by city and service.
current_stage_5.tests: Current focused regression including Stage 5, CSRF, Instagram, Booking Bridge, gallery, CTA and Buti AI: 70 passed, 132 warnings. Broader beauty-center sweep: 80 passed, 10 failed in older stage 7/10/12/13/14 and admin-bot expectations.
current_stage_5.smoke: Python compilation, public/owner/admin Jinja compilation passed. GET /beauty-centers returned HTTP 200 and rendered all four prior KPIs plus the demand section with an explicit empty state in the current zero-active-service environment.
